description: This file defines the Upload model class within the Opencart e-commerce platform. It provides methods to add an upload record to the database and retrieve upload details by code, facilitating file upload management in the application.

classes.name: Upload
classes.description: Model class for handling file uploads, including creating new upload records and retrieving upload details by code.

methods.name: addUpload
methods.description: Creates a new upload record in the database with the provided name and filename, returning a unique code associated with the upload.

methods.name: getUploadByCode
methods.description: Retrieves upload information from the database based on the provided unique code.
